technical.summary: Long-term structure is bullish but short-term momentum is weak with price below key moving averages, low ADX, and no confirmed entry triggers; risk/reward unfavorable for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 87 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal: congressional trades are stale (>500 days old), market sentiment is neutral with mild greed, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (90.4) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 87 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) suggests uptrend intact with price near support (68.04) offering defined risk entry for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 90.4), weak short-term momentum (price below EMA 9/21, RSI not bullish, ADX 21.74 no trend), zero fundamental conviction (no insider/institutional buying, earnings risk in 87 days), and no active entry triggers make risk/reward unfavorable.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term structure remains bullish with price near support, but severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) combined with weak short-term momentum and zero fundamental conviction create unfavorable risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX at crisis levels (90.4) signal systemic market stress that could trigger sharp reversals regardless of technical support levels.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish macro environment and weak entry quality
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AOS with 20 existing Industrials positions (23.8% of portfolio); concentration risk and sector saturation argue against adding exposure.
